subject: Aurelia Health: entitlement and SSO/SCIM evidence request
messages:
From: Nadia Torres <n.torres@aureliahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Security Team <security@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: entitlement export + SAML/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Mateo,

We are finalizing Aurelia Health's SIG/CAIQ review and need a focused access-control evidence package from Redwood covering SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC and least-privilege proofs. Specifically we need: 

- a full entitlement export for the Aurelia tenant (CSV) showing user -> role assignments and service account bindings for the last 90 days
- SAML assertion samples (3 unique user assertions) that include NotBefore / NotOnOrAfter timestamps and NameID (can be hashed)
- SCIM delta snapshot for the same 90-day window (showing adds/mods/removes)
- role-to-resource mapping or a short README explaining how roles map to product permissions
- a short note on how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts and ephemeral admin sessions

We understand some PII may need redaction; please indicate if you can provide full unredacted extracts under an NDA or whether we should accept hashed identifiers. Target turnaround is 72 hours if possible. Let me know if you need a narrower scope.

Thanks,
Nadia Torres
Info Security Engineer
Aurelia Health

(attachment: none)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nadia Torres <n.torres@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: entitlement export + SAML/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Nadia — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the package and aim to deliver by end of day Friday, Oct 2. Planned contents: 

- entitlement_export_2026-09-29.csv (user, role, resource, assignment_ts, source)
- saml-assertions-sample-2026-09-29.txt (3 anonymized assertions with NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter preserved)
- scim-delta-snapshot-2026-09-29.json (90-day window, change_type annotated)
- leastpriv-rollup-README.md (explanation for service accounts, ephemeral admin flow, and RBAC scoping)

Notes/asks: 
- by default we will hash user emails and NameIDs; if you need unredacted identifiers we can accommodate under an inbound NDA or secure transfer — confirm preferred method
- do you need audit/session logs (token issue events) in addition to the scim deltas? that may push the timeline by a day depending on retention retrieval.

I'll coordinate with Soojin and Sean to assemble redaction-safe artifacts. If you'd like a 15-minute sync tomorrow to walk the package, happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Security Liaison, Redwood Inference

(attachments: planned)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Aurelia evidence plan

mateo / sean — quick plan and division of work for Aurelia packet: 

- entitlement export: I'll run the tenant extract filtered to Aurelia tenant id and include columns: account_id, principal_type, principal_hash, role_id, role_name, assignment_ts, source. Output as entitlement_export_2026-09-29.csv. I'll drop any email PII (hash) unless Nadia confirms unredacted transfer.
- scim-delta: Sean please pull the provisioning delta for 2026-06-30 to 2026-09-29 and include change_type/add/mod/remove, actor, timestamp. Save as scim-delta-snapshot-2026-09-29.json (redacted actor email -> hash).
- saml assertions: I'll pull 3 recent successful login assertions for different users, remove any email plaintext but preserve NameID hash and assertion timestamps (NotBefore / NotOnOrAfter). Put in saml-assertions-sample-2026-09-29.txt.
- leastpriv README: I'll draft leastpriv-rollup-README.md describing role scoping, service account policies, just-in-time admin flows and links to configuration docs.

Open question: do we include token issuance events (authn logs) or only the assertion samples? If authn logs are requested, retention lookup shows partial older entries; that could extend delivery to Oct 3. If Nadia confirms no logs, we can ship Oct 2 EOD.

I'll start running the exports now and will upload staged artifacts to the secure Drive link.

soojin
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

(attachments: none yet)

From: Nadia Torres <n.torres@aureliahealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Security Team <security@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: entitlement export + SAML/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Thanks Mateo — Oct 2 EOD works. A couple of small clarifications: 

- please ensure the SAML assertion samples explicitly include NotBefore and NotOnOrAfter values and the raw assertion issue timestamps; hashed NameIDs are fine.
- add a tenant mapping CSV (tenant_id -> human-readable org name) to the package so our reviewers can reconcile rows in the entitlement export.
- no need for full authn token logs for this pass; assertion samples + scim delta + entitlement export are sufficient.

If you can upload to the HubSpot record or the secure Drive link you mentioned, we'll pick it up from there. Looking forward to the README explaining least-privilege enforcement.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Nadia
Info Security Engineer, Aurelia Health

On Thu, Sep 30, 2026 at 10:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Nadia — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the package and aim to deliver by end of day Friday, Oct 2.

(attachments expected: entitlement_export_2026-09-29.csv; saml-assertions-sample-2026-09-29.txt; scim-delta-snapshot-2026-09-29.json; leastpriv-rollup-README.md)
